evidence.text: Directly inspected the supplied full-page scan. Under 學(学), the entry states “本义是学习、效法,” proposing learning and emulation/following as a model as the original meaning. evidence.source: 李學勤主編《字源》；學(学) entry credited to 張標
evidence.field: PDF p. 277, printed p. 265; formation discussion, verified against full page and supplied crop
evidence.text: The printed passage distinguishes proposals. One rare printed form is read jù and described as “两手或两爪之象” (two hands or claws); the glyph is not safely identifiable as a Unicode character. The next proposal is separate: “或从两臼（毚片）从冖，[臼]亦声（两臼或省作人形）,” involving two 臼 forms with 冖. Thus the scan supports a rare jù element and a separate two-臼 proposal; it does not gloss the rare graph as 踞 or identify it as 臼. The adjacent crop contains the target line and distinguishing text. evidence.source: 教育部《國語辭典簡編本》2021
evidence.field: 學 entry, pronunciation and present-day senses, lines 28–38
evidence.text: The entry gives Mandarin xué. It directly illustrates the study/practice verb sense with 學工夫 and 學技術, and imitation with 有樣學樣. It lists a place for receiving education and seeking knowledge, illustrated only by compounds 小學、中學、大學. This supports current learning/study use; its school examples establish 學 as a compound morpheme, not a standalone current word meaning “school.”
evidence.title: 教育部《國語辭典簡編本》2021 — 學

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Chinese University of Hong Kong)
evidence.field: 學 entry, Han-slip usage report returned in search; direct page open failed
evidence.text: The returned entry text reports that in Han slips 學 is used as a loan spelling for 覺 in the sense “feel,” citing 《張家山漢簡．引書》: “學(覺)心腹及匈(胸)中有痛者，無(撫)之以手”. The cited wording is source-reported; the entry did not open directly in this invocation, so the slip context was not independently inspected. No phonological rationale for the borrowing is established by the accessible result.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 — 學

search_audit.outcome: Search returned a National Museum of Classical Books page discussing 教、学、斅, bibliographic metadata, and a four-page OCR excerpt of 字源 front matter and unrelated pages. The online PDF does not include the target entry. The supplied p. 277 and p. 278 scan images and p. 277 crop were visually inspected directly.

gaps: The rare jù glyph on 《字源》 PDF p. 277 (printed p. 265) is unresolved as a Unicode identity; retain it as a scan-bound form. The separate two-臼 wording is legible and must not be conflated with it.

The CUHK 学/學 page for the Han-slip quotation timed out on direct open. Its search result supplies the example, but the slip’s context and the source’s full discussion could not be inspected in this invocation. No source inspected here establishes the phonological basis for writing 覺 with 學.

Modern dictionary evidence supports 学/學 for study and learning, and supports a school/place sense through compounds 小學、中學、大學. Evidence for standalone contemporary 学/學 meaning “school” was not found here.
